metadata.description: AlphaAbsolute Thailand Screening System — Full Knowledge Export for AI Training
metadata.universe: SET Focus List — top-RS stocks from SET100 + high-momentum SET universe (~60-100 tickers)
metadata.hit_rate_definition: fraction of observations where fwd_return > 0 (any positive return counts)
metadata.fire_rate_definition: fraction of all ticker-days where signal fires (rarity measure)
metadata.benchmark: TDEX.BK — SET50 ETF (tracking error ~0.3% vs SET index)

alphamodel_th.description: AlphaAbsolute Thailand alpha model: RS-based weekly momentum rotation in SET market. Ranks all Focus List stocks by multi-horizon RS, holds top-N, rebalances weekly.

locked_baseline.note: DELTA.BK included as contributor not drag. DO NOT change without CIO approval.

rs_formula.description: Relative Strength formula used in AlphaModel-TH for SET universe ranking
rs_formula.input: Daily close prices (split/div adjusted) from ohlcv.db

balanced.note: Most weight on 12M trend; 1M adds recency bias. Chosen in champion config.

momentum_tilt.note: More responsive; tested but not in COMBINED baseline.

rs_formula.ranking: All Focus List tickers ranked by RS_score → top_n selected each rebalance
rs_formula.champion_lookback: 21 days (best Sharpe per DD unit in SET; 63d/252d have similar excess but lower Sharpe)

regime_gate.rule: Only hold positions when TDEX.BK close > 50-day MA; else 100% cash
regime_gate.effect: MA50 gate lifts CAGR from 6% (no gate) to 24% (MA50 gate) vs 33% COMBINED

sizing_methods.vol_parity: position_weight = (1/vol_20d) normalized to sum=1; lower-vol stocks get larger weight
sizing_methods.note: vol_parity beats equal_weight: same return, lower MaxDD in SET universe

A.name: Breakout
A.description: Price clears N-day high, with or without volume confirmation
A.note: SET fakes breakouts frequently — pure breakout h5 near 31-45%, below baseline.

B.name: Tight Base
B.description: Price range compressed; stock hugging high — coiled spring setup

C.name: Early Move
C.description: Small positive return, stock above MA50 — early accumulation signal

E.name: Pullback to MA
E.description: Price returns to MA20 or MA50 zone in uptrend — continuation setup

key_formulas.e2_pb_ma50: ma50 * 0.97 <= close <= ma50 * 1.03 AND close > ma20

F.name: Volume Dry-Up (VDU)
F.description: Volume drying up — institutions not selling; supply exhausted
F.note: F-family is most powerful as COMPONENT — 'dry_near_X' combos with J/N/K families excel.

H.name: Momentum Resume
H.description: 5-day return positive, new 10-day high — trend continuation

I.name: Short-Term (1-3 day)
I.description: Close quality, power moves, gap holds, reversal candles

key_formulas.i1_close_quality: close in top 25% of day range AND vol >= vol20
key_formulas.i4_2down_bounce: 2 consecutive down closes THEN today up
key_formulas.i5_cap_reversal: prev: down > 2% on 2x_vol THEN today up
key_formulas.i6_nr7_close_hi: g2_nr7 AND close in top 50% of range
key_formulas.i7_dry_up_near_hi: today up AND vol < vol20*0.70 AND pct_from_hi20 between -6% and +1%
key_formulas.i9_inside_close_hi: g1_inside_bar AND close in top 50% of range

J.name: Support Confluence + Dry Volume
J.description: Price at specific MA/swing level WITH low volume — institutional accumulation signal

key_formulas.j1_dry_near_ma10: vol < vol20*0.70 AND ma10*0.98 <= close <= ma10*1.02
key_formulas.j2_dry_near_ma20: vol < vol20*0.70 AND ma20*0.98 <= close <= ma20*1.03
key_formulas.j3_dry_near_ma50: vol < vol20*0.70 AND ma50*0.97 <= close <= ma50*1.03
key_formulas.j6_dry_near_swing_lo: vol < vol20*0.70 AND near 5-30d swing low support
key_formulas.j7_vcp_zone_ma20: vol < vol20*0.70 AND pct_from_hi between -8% and -3% AND near_ma20
key_formulas.j8_pb_zone_ma50: vol < vol20*0.70 AND pct_from_hi between -15% and -5% AND near_ma50

J.note: J-family consistently top performers when combined with F (volume dry-up). J3+F1+J6 combination at h5=68.4% (N=57) — one of the highest-N strong signals.

K.name: First Pullback After Breakout
K.description: O'Neil: first pullback after 3-month breakout has highest continuation probability

key_formulas.k1_first_pb_after_bkt: 63d_high within last 30d AND pb_from_bkt between -8% and -3% AND vol < vol20*0.85
key_formulas.k4_first_pb_to_ma20: 63d_high within last 30d AND near_ma20 AND vol < vol20*0.85

M.name: VDU + Expansion Day
M.description: Minervini: 3 days declining volume then expansion up-day (spring loading pattern)

key_formulas.m1_vdu_expansion: vol[-3], vol[-2], vol[-1] all declining THEN today: vol > avg(prior_3d) AND today_up

N.name: Pocket Pivot at MA
N.description: Morales/Kacher: up-day volume exceeds any down-day volume in prior 10 days, at key MA

O.name: SMC — Smart Money Concepts
O.description: Fair Value Gap (FVG) and Change of Character (CHoCH) from Smart Money Concepts framework

key_formulas.o1_in_fvg_3d: price inside bullish FVG formed in last 3 bars (gap between bar[-2].high and bar[0].low where bar[-1] is gap bar)
key_formulas.o2_choch_10d: close > max_close_prior_10d (simplified CHoCH: breaking recent swing high)

O.note: FVG signals critical for SET — Thai market = FVG+Volume+Structure works better than pure momentum.

P.name: TD Sequential
P.description: Tom DeMark TD Sequential for exhaustion timing on SET

key_formulas.p2_td_setup_9: 9 consecutive closes each below the close 4 bars prior (Setup complete)
key_formulas.p5_td_countdown_13: 13+ countdown bars where close <= low 2 bars prior

P.academic_source: Chen, Huang & Kuan (2016): TD Setup 9 on SET → 58% win rate, 5d alpha +1.1%

Q.name: PULSE-TH Composite Q-Signals
Q.description: Multi-indicator Q-signals from PULSE-TH systematic library. Each Q-signal is a specific combination of A-P family signals.
Q.note: See pulse_th_library section for full Q-signal details with hit rates.

pulse_th_library.description: PULSE-TH: systematic Q-signal library for SET market. Tests all multi-indicator combinations for forward return predictability.
pulse_th_library.how_it_works: 1. For each ticker-day: compute all 993 signals (families A-P). 2. For each Q-signal (combo of 2-5 indicators): check if ALL components fire. 3. Record forward returns (fwd1/2/3/5 days). 4. Grade Q-signals by h3/h5 hit rate across all observations.

grade_definitions.S_BOTH: h3 >= 63% AND h5 >= 63% AND n >= 15 (strong signal at both 3d and 5d horizon)

key_patterns: Best S_BOTH cluster: J3+F1+J6+J8_pb_zone_ma50 combos → h3=h5=84.2% (N=19)
Best high-N cluster: I9+I8+FVG5 combos → h3=h5=80.0% (N=20)
Best single-signal: Q20_q9_above_ma50 → h5=71.0%, avg_ret=5.13%, N=31
Thai insight: FVG (Fair Value Gap) + Volume + MA-confluence beats pure momentum

pulse_breadth_scoring.description: Daily PULSE-TH output: for each ticker, count how many quality Q-signals fire today. High breadth = multiple independent indicators agree = higher conviction.

fields.breadth: count of quality Q-signals firing for this ticker today
fields.breadth_pct: breadth / n_quality_signals * 100 — what % of quality library agrees
fields.avg_h3: weighted avg expected 3-day hit rate from all firing signals
fields.n_quality: total quality signals in library (Grade A+S+S_BOTH)

thai_paper_portfolio.entry_trigger: PULSE breadth >= threshold AND regime = MA50 above (TDEX.BK > MA50)
thai_paper_portfolio.exit_trigger: Weekly rebalance: RS drops below top-N cutoff

alphamodel_th_insights: RS lookback 21d (1 month) is optimal for SET — shorter is better than longer for momentum capture
Top-N=10 is sweet spot: Top5 gives higher CAGR but higher MaxDD; Top15+ drops sharply in both
MA50 regime gate (TDEX.BK above MA50): without it CAGR = 6%, with it = 24% — mandatory for live trading
Vol-parity sizing reduces MaxDD vs equal-weight without sacrificing return
COMBINED config (all best params together) CAGR 33.2% — synergistic, not just additive
DELTA.BK: included in universe, proven contributor (removed it = lower Sharpe)
signal_insights: Volume Dry-Up (F-family) is most powerful as a COMPONENT — add it to any support signal
J-family (dry near MA/swing support) + F-family = most consistent high-N performers
J3+F1+J6 = h5=68.4% at N=57 — high enough N to be actionable
SET market rewards: price at support (J) + low supply (F) + inside/reversal (I/G) combos
Pure breakout (A-family) h5=31-45% — below baseline — SET fakes breakouts too often
FVG (O-family) in combinations is powerful — O1+I9+I8 cluster h3=h5=80% (N=20)
TD Sequential P2 (Setup 9) with MA50 above: h5=71% — academic validation confirmed
First pullback after breakout (K-family): strong conceptually but N too small for SET
breadth_logic: Single signal fires on 0.1-0.3% of ticker-days (very rare = highly selective)
PULSE breadth: count of quality signals agreeing on one stock on one day
Breadth > 5% of quality library = noteworthy; >10% = high conviction
On 2026-09-29: HANA.BK only ticker with breadth>0 (breadth=7, breadth_pct=25%, avg_h3=68.8%)
Low breadth day = no signals = stay in cash (normal for SET in sideways)
what_does_not_work_in_set: Pure price breakout without volume: h5 near or below baseline (45.7%)
HOT theme bonus (lowering RS threshold for themes): REJECTED — underperformed +3.9pp
Monthly rebalance: CAGR 6.7% vs weekly 13% — SET needs frequent rotation
Top-25 stock universe: CAGR -4.2% — too diluted
Long lookback RS (252d alone): CAGR lower, higher DD vs 21d
No regime gate: CAGR 6% vs 24% — devastating in bear market (MaxDD -49.6%)
thai_market_character: SET responds better to structure (FVG, support levels) than pure momentum
Volume dry-up at support is THE most reliable pattern
Market rotates faster than US — 21d RS more useful than 252d
Institutional stop-hunts common — need soft tolerance around MAs (-3%/-5%)
Holiday density high: 2026 has 16+ SET trading holidays — must filter calendar
